name: @nomadspeak/mobile-app
description: NomadSpeak – English learning app for Mongolian learners

scripts.android:assemble:debug: npm run android:prepare:web && (cd android && (./gradlew assembleDebug || gradle assembleDebug))
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run android:prepare:web && node ./node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor update android
scripts.android:bundle:release: npm run android:prepare:web && (cd android && (./gradlew bundleRelease || gradle bundleRelease))
